kind: # Naturalness-Ta v1 CAPABILITY source, authored for task B4 part 2 (D-020, D-021).
# Tamil drafted with AI assistance. NEEDS THE OPERATOR'S REVIEW before the vault is frozen:
# the measurement is only as good as the Tamil, and no downstream rigour repairs a
# sentence that reads oddly to a Tamil speaker.
# THREE KINDS, and the difference between the first two is the whole point:
#  event  - a sentence with a natural place to breathe, sigh or clear the throat, with
#           the model's OWN non-verbal token sitting at that place. Only the sixteen
#           tokens in geetha/text/contract.py may appear; C2 measured that all sixteen
#           are INERT in the base model, so this is the binary capability gap and the
#           system, including the base model and the three paid APIs).
#  filler - a hesitation written as Tamil WORDS ("அதாவது", "உம்", "என்ன சொல்ல வரேன்").
#           There is NO filler token in the contract, so the base model can say these
#           perfectly well. This is a difference of DEGREE -- does the hesitation sound
#           like hesitation or like a word being read -- and it is reported as such.
#           Claiming it inside the binary gap would be overclaiming. expected_events is
#           0 for every filler item: nothing acoustic is asked for.
#  clean  - fluent read-aloud Tamil with no invitation to hesitate. A breath or filler
#           HERE is a defect, and these items give the false-positive rate. Without
#           them "events per minute" rewards a model that wheezes through every
#           sentence, which is exactly the unfalsifiable shape D-020 removed from the
# Every prompt must render in ONE pass (<= 180 spoken characters). B7 revision 1
# truncated 145 of 262 prompts; a chunked naturalness prompt carries a pause the writer
